source.interpretation: One point = one person, as requested. Other attributes are not used.
source.coverage: Completeness and reference year are not verified.

method: Transform point coordinates to EPSG:3006; floor(x/100), floor(y/100); one point contributes once. Mask 1-10 before packaging; retain exact counts above 10.
noDataPolicy: Omitted cells have no source points and are not displayed. This is not proof of zero residents in reality.
disclosure: Counts 1-10 are packaged as [1,10]; counts above 10 have equal min/max and are exact. No original point coordinates or attributes. Heights use 5.5 for 1-10 and exact counts above 10. Totals retain lower/upper bounds while masked cells are included.
